t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The goal is to get as many mushrooms as possible. Two gnomes will appear. If they are orange, green, red or blue, you will go to the bright forest. If they are pink, yellow, brown or black then you will go to the dark forest.You may get a multiplier of 1x or 5x at any time in the challenge

vb_textbox.text: Hi.This game involves collecting as many mushrooms as you can from the gardens of gnomes. You will be presented with two gnomes in which you must press 'S' or 'K' to choose one. Once you choose one, you will be taken to a dark garden with a red basket or a bright garden with a yellow basket.The colour of the gnome will depend on which garden you go to. If it is red, green, blue or orange; you will go to the dark forest. If the gnome is brown, pink or yellow; you will go to the light forest. It is up to you to determine what the method is to get the most amount of mushrooms but it is dependent if you end up in the light forest or the dark forest.You may also get a multiplier of x5 during the task, pay attention during these tasks as they will determine if you get more mushrooms.The size of the gnome and the shape of his mat won't matter.How many mushrooms you get determines the amount of bonus you receive at the end.
